messages.subject: Re: multiple plots in one
parts:
You'd likely have to extract out the information that you want passed to ggplot2 since there's no direct connection from the lattice plotting system to ggplot. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

Phil


On Sun, Jul 10, 2022 at 10:43 AM 'C K' via mirt-package <mirt-p...@googlegroups.com> wrote:
Hey Phil,

I've recently plotted the standard errors of theta as a funciton of theta for multiple models like this: 
#generate mirt model
 fit.SKIDDETdisc <- mirt(SKIDDetachmentdisc,1,pars = par.SKIDDETdisc,method = "EM") fit.SKIDNAdisc <- mirt(SKIDNAdisc,1,pars = par.SKIDNAdisc,method = "EM") 

  #plot the SE(theta) as a function of theta
plot(fit.SKIDDETdisc, type = "infoSE", theta_lim =c(-4,4))
plot (fit.SKIDNAdisc, type = "infoSE", theta_lim = c(-4,4))

I would like to combine these plots in one plot but with ggplot2 I get the error message, that the data must be a data.frame and my data is a SingleClassGroup unfortunately.. Is there any possibility to do this with this data type?
